Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use an Arcane Focus or tool as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Craft

A quiet room for research, with one or more desks and bookshelves.

Arcane Study Charm. After you spend a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm (see Supernatural Gifts) that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. It lets you cast Identify without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Arcane Focus. The hireling crafts an Arcane Focus in 7 days, at no cost. It stays in your Bastion until you claim it.

Craft: Book. The hireling crafts a blank book in 7 days, for 10 GP. It stays in your Bastion until you claim it.

Craft: Magic Item (Arcana). If you are level 9+, the hireling can craft a Common or Uncommon magic item of your choice from the Arcana tables of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The facility has the required tool, and the hireling is proficient with it and with Arcana; use the Crafting Magic Items rules for the time and cost. If the item lets its user cast spells, you must craft it yourself (the hireling can assist) and have those spells prepared every day you spend crafting.
